name: Cordova
description: A fictional country where partners finance a large share of the food-system budget through projects on budget (lines tagged external). A partner withdrawal at t3 removes most external project money on the five most partner-financed components, and the record shows the jump in stress and its slow decay. Synthetic demonstration data.
